\section{Checked input contract}

The raw frontend receives an ordinary indexed Boolean gate DAG with exactly
$n$ declared independent input bits and one final Boolean output. It exposes
actual degree-at-most-two marked registers, reverses a recognized literal
reversible suffix, and obtains a complete-register equality target. Its
shared-DAG traversal visits each wire once; unknown high-degree polynomials
are not truncated. Its algebraic certificates manufacture a source-free
polar split and a simple left nucleus $S\simeq M_p(F)$, $F=\F_{2^a}$.
Internal circuit wires never become independent inputs.

The affine-Hom frontend checks the complete marked identity and supplies
actual binary modules $U,O$, an injective map $\iota:V\to H=\Hom_S(U,O)$,
and $h_0\in H$. Require $\dim_2U=\dim_2O=apd$.
Writing $W=\iota(V)$, the reduced equation is
\begin{equation}\label{eq:eval}
 (h_0+\iota(v))(u)=y,\qquad u\in U,\quad v\in V.
\end{equation}
The full marked target is $b=c_0+P_Oy$ for an acquired injective binary map
$P_O$ into the marked-register space. Target consistency is therefore an
explicit binary linear condition.

The original input map $x=x_{\rm aff}+J(u,v)$ is a known affine bijection.
The offsets after affine-Hom acquisition, not the earlier polar offset,
must be used. If the initial split gave $B(u,v)+L(u)+R(v)+c$ with
$R(v)=B(u_0,v)$, then
\[
 x_{\rm aff}=x_{\rm split}+J(u_0,0),\qquad
 c_0=c+L(u_0),\qquad h_0=L.
\]
The exact certificate keys are \path|original_affine_input_offset| and
\path|original_input_coordinate_columns|.

The acquired reverse-Hom pairing is
\[
 \langle D,T\rangle=\tau(DT),\quad
 D\in\Hom_S(O,U),\quad T\in H,
\]
where $\tau$ is a nonzero binary functional annihilating all commutators
in $\End_S(U)$. Abstractly
$\tau(Z)=\operatorname{Tr}_{F/\F_2}(\gamma\tr Z)$ for $\gamma\ne0$.
This is the reduced trace functional, not the trace of a large represented
binary action matrix, which can vanish at even multiplicity.

Let $\mathcal D=W^\perp$ be the actual reverse-Hom dual. The preceding
regular matrix-dual acquisition checks the full multiplier algebra
\[
 A=\{T\in\End_S(U):T\mathcal D\subseteq\mathcal D\}
      \simeq\prod_{i=1}^b M_{s_i}(F).
\]

Verdict

No mathematical correction was required in the reviewed proof or algorithm.
The construction acquires the previously proof-only isomorphism D0, completes
an arbitrary affine partial trace to an invertible map, and produces an exact
original-input affine section for every consistent marked output. Its
expected-polynomial qualification and its distinction from uniform full-fiber
sampling are necessary and correctly stated.

Reviewed versions

acquired_affine_section.py SHA256:
6db389f9cfdc069a2b3e3cc6cbe5eab70477e7a974229ee10dfe95b6c5b7b915

Both files are in new_work/independent_audit. This review also read the
recovered affine-Hom reconstruction, actual matrix-multiplier acquisition,
manufactured matrix-coordinate code, and primitive-corner splitting argument.

1. D0 is constructed, not assumed

The code restricts each regular dual component to a primitive left idempotent,
uses the actual common scalar action to choose an F-basis of e_i D_i, and
transports its s_i basis maps to the pairwise orthogonal primitive images by
connecting units. Their sum belongs to the actual dual.

If that sum kills a vector, each orthogonal output projection shows that each
chosen primitive map kills it. The connecting unit is injective on the first
primitive image. Their full algebra translates span the regular component,
so the common-kernel certificate forces the vector to vanish. Equal U and O
dimensions imply invertibility. The dimension comparison then gives
A D0 = D. There is no hidden cyclic-vector or invertible-combination search.

The independent replay recomputed D0 with a new random seed, checked its
inverse on every output basis vector, and checked equality of the actual
binary spans A D0 and D. These checks passed.

then gives the full matrix-unit multiplication identities.

## C. Constructing one invertible affine representative

For a regular dual D=A D0 with actual common scalar operators, zero common
kernel and equal source/target dimension, choose field bases in primitive
left ideals and transport them by connecting matrix units. Their images lie
in orthogonal primitive summands. The resulting sum D0 is injective by the
common-kernel condition, hence invertible by equal dimensions; the regular
dimension identity gives A D0=D. Equal field degrees alone are insufficient.

Under multiplicity h_i>=2, each affine partial-trace condition can be met by
an invertible block companion matrix: for h=2 use [[H,I],[I,0]], and for
higher h use the forward cycle with H on its first diagonal. Thus one fixed
h* lies in h0+W and is invertible. The original affine section
sigma(y)=x_aff+J(h*^-1 y,v*) works for every consistent marked output.
It is a search operation, independent of c, target-carrier arrangement and
one-copy target restrictions. It is not the full-fiber counting or uniform
sampling operation. A coefficient-by-coefficient quadratic composition
certificate is stronger than a few target probes. Multiplicity one can
defeat this invertible-transversal construction; that is not preimage-search
hardness or a claim that all other sections fail.

The supplied section review pins code 6db389f9...; final code fc529c59... adds
exactly sys.dont_write_bytecode=True. Removing that line in memory reconstructs
the reviewed hash. The historical review is not silently retargeted; this
review read the entire final module and this operational delta. The later
source pipeline separately pins the final version. Saved executions remain
source executions, not intake replay.
